param_1012,The Misthalin area covers the entire Kingdom of Misthalin along with Fossil Island, Zanaris and the Abyss.

Instances of areas in Misthalin and underground areas with an entrance in Misthalin will also be included.

Access to Al Kharid, Port Sarim and the western exit of Barbarian Village is blocked by magical barriers.

All transportation and teleportation through Charter Ships, Customs Officers, Gnome Gliders, Fairy Rings, Balloons, or any other transport system will require you to have unlocked access to the area your destination is in.

The following travel options are restricted unless you have access to the appropriate area:

- The gate between Lumbridge and Al Kharid
- The entrance to the Kalphite Hive from Dorgesh Kaan Dungeon
- The grapple shortcut between Lumbridge and Al Kharid
- The stepping stone between Lumbridge Swamp and the Kalphite Lair
- The under-wall shortcut between Draynor Village and Port Sarim
- The underground sections of the Paterdomus Temple
- The railing shortcut between the Paterdomus Temple and Canifis

param_1013,Notable Settlements:

- Barbarian Village
- Draynor Village
- Edgeville
- Fossil Island
- Lumbridge
- The Digsite
- Varrock
- Zanaris
- Isle of Souls and Soul Wars

Notable combat-related activities:

- Abyssal Sire
- Bryophyta
- Chaeldar Slayer Tasks
- Edgeville Dungeon
- Fossil Island Wyverns
- Lumbridge Swamp Caves
- Obor
- Stronghold of Security
- Vannaka Slayer Tasks

Notable non-combat activities:

- Champions' Guild
- Draynor Village Rooftop Agility Course
- Fossil Island Herbiboar
- Fossil Island Hardwood Tree Patches
- Fossil Island Sulliusceps Woodcutting
- Fossil Island Volcanic Mine
- Puro-Puro Implings
- Cosmic, Earth and Water Altars
- Varrock Rooftop Agility Course

Thessalia in Varrock will offer additional makeover services.

All Slayer Masters will assign tasks from the same Slayer list and assign the same number of Slayer Points on task completion.

Slayer Tasks will still respect Slayer and Combat Level requirements.

Elemental Shields have been added to all Slayer Equipment shops.

Unlocking Misthalin will add the following tasks to your Slayer list:

- Cows (while under level 50 Combat)
- Goblins (while under level 50 Combat)
- Minotaurs (while under level 50 Combat)
- Zombies (while under level 50 Combat)
- Abyssal Demons
- Ankou
- Fossil Island Wyverns
- Hill Giants
- Moss Giants
- Spiders

The following Misthalin shop stocks have been modified:

- Pestle and Mortars have been added to the Lumbridge General Store
- Black Platelegs have been added to Horvik's Armour Shop

param_1014,The following quests and their pre-reqs are automatically completed but will not reward any completion XP:

- Dragon Slayer
- Druidic Ritual
- Elemental Workshop I
- Tears of Guthix
- Bone Voyage
- Fairytale II - Cure a Queen

The following tasks in the Lumbridge and Draynor Achievement Diary are automatically completed:

Easy Tasks:
- Catch some Anchovies in Al Kharid
- Mine some iron ore at the Al Kharid mine

Medium Tasks:
- Complete a lap of the Al Kharid Rooftop Course
- Grapple across the River Lum
- Craft some Lava Runes at the Fire Altar in Al Kharid
- Purchase an upgraded device from Ava

Hard Tasks:
- Cast Bones to Peaches in Al Kharid Palace
- Light your Mining Helmet in Lumbridge Basement
- Collect 100 tears from Tears of Guthix
- Recharge your Prayer at the Emir's Arena with Smite activated
- Purchase some Barrows Gloves from the Culinaromancer's Chest
- Take the train from Dorgesh-Kaan to Keldagrim

Elite Tasks:
- Chop some Magic Logs at the Mage Training Arena
- Steal from a Dorgesh-Kaan rich chest
- Pickpocket Movario on the Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course
- Perform the Quest Point Cape emote in the Wise Old Man's house

The following tasks in the Varrock Diary are automatically completed:

Medium Tasks:
- Select a colour for your kitten
- Use the Spirit Tree in the north-eastern corner of Grand Exchange
- Pick a White Tree Fruit
- Use the balloon to travel from Varrock

Hard Tasks:
- Trade furs with the Fancy Dress Seller for a Spottier Cape and equip it
- Teleport to Paddewwa

Elite Tasks:
- Use Lunar magic to make 20 Mahogany Planks in the Varrock Lumber Yard
- Smith and fletch ten Rune Darts while in Varrock

- Every Clue Scroll casket will roll the max amount of rewards it can give. (It can roll the same item more than once) :

- Medium caskets will roll 5 times.
- Hard caskets will roll 6 times.
- Elite caskets will roll 6 times.
- Master caskets will roll 7 times.

- There is a chance when opening a clue casket that you will receive another casket of the same tier. This is more common the lower the casket tier.

- There is also a chance for this additional casket to be upgraded to a tier above the one you opened.

- All Clue Scrolls have the lowest number of steps possible for their tier.

- Every Clue Scroll casket will roll the max amount of rewards it can give. (It can roll the same item more than once) :

- Beginner caskets will roll 3 times.
- Easy caskets will roll 4 times.
- Medium caskets will roll 5 times.
- Hard caskets will roll 6 times.
- Elite caskets will roll 6 times.
- Master caskets will roll 7 times.

- There is a chance when opening a clue casket that you will receive another casket of the same tier. This is more common the lower the casket tier.

- There is also a chance for this additional casket to be upgraded to a tier above the one you opened.

fields.value:
param_880,- Upon selecting this Relic, you will receive a set of Trailblazer Tools which can be used with no requirements. The Pickaxe and Axe will do their respective skilling actions 0.6 seconds quicker than their normal tool equivalent, and the Harpoon increases Fishing speed by 1.2s. All three tools have the same bonuses as Crystal tier tools.

- Any ore mined with the Trailblazer Pickaxe will be smelted into a bar, and Smithing XP given, regardless of Smithing level.

- Any fish caught with the Trailblazer Harpoon will be cooked, and Cooking XP given, regardless of Cooking level. This will work even for fish that don't require a Harpoon to be caught if the Trailblazer Harpoon is equipped or in your Inventory.

- Any logs chopped with the Trailblazer Axe will be burned, and Firemaking XP given, regardless of Firemaking level.

- On death, these tools are lost and can be reclaimed from the Sage in Lumbridge.

- As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- Tempoross, 1 ticket
- Wintertodt, 1 ticket
- Zalcano, 3 tickets
- Barbarian Assault, 10 tickets
(Upon finishing wave 10)

Tickets can be earned by receiving loot from the following combat activities:
- Sarachnis, 1 ticket
- King Black Dragon, 1 ticket
- Dagannoth Kings, 1 ticket
- Kalphite Queen, 2 tickets
- Commander Zilyana, 5 tickets
- General Graardor, 5 tickets
- K'ril Tsutsaroth, 5 tickets
- Kree'arra, 5 tickets
- The Nightmare, 2 tickets
(Phosani's Nightmare excl.)
- Nex, 2 tickets
- Corporeal Beast, 5 tickets
- Chambers of Xeric, 10 tickets
- Challenge Mode, 20 tickets
- Theatre of Blood, 15 tickets
- Story Mode, 3 tickets
- Hard Mode, 20 tickets

param_1012,The Kebos and Kourend area covers the entirety of Kebos and Kourend.

Instances of areas in Kebos and Kourend and underground areas with an entrance in Kebos and Kourend will also be included.

All transportation and teleportation via Charter Ships, Customs Officers, Gnome Gliders, Fairy Rings, Balloons and all other forms of transport will require you to have unlocked access to the area your destination is in.

param_1013,Notable Settlements:

- Hosidius
- Arceuus
- Lovakengj
- Port Piscarilius
- Shayzien
- Kingstown
- Northern Tundras
- Kourend Woodland
- Mount Karuulm
- Kebos Swamp
- Mount Quidamortem
- The Stranglewood

Notable combat-related activities:

- Chambers of Xeric
- Vardorvis (With the Kharidian Desert unlocked)
- Lizardman Shaman
- Mount Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
- Sarachnis (Forthos Dungeon)
- Catacombs of Kourend
- Giants' Den

Notable non-combat activities:

- Farming Guild
- Woodcutting Guild
-Arceuus Library
- Hosidius House Portal
- Tithe Farm
- Lake Molch Aerial Fishing
- The Wintertodt
- Soul and Blood Altar
- Blast Mine

Konar will assign Slayer Tasks based on the areas you have unlocked.

Slayer Tasks will still respect Slayer and Combat Level requirements.

Elemental Shields have been added to all Slayer Equipment shops.
Unlocking Kourend will add the following Tasks to your Slayer list:

- Lizardmen
- Red Dragons
- Wyrms
- Drakes
- Hydras
- Bloodvelds

- X Marks the Spot

- Increased Damage taken by 25%

- Unique chance will be multiplied by 3 (E.g Leagues unique multiplier x5 turns into x15).

-The drops listed below are affected by the drop rate modifier perks granted by passive Relic unlocks.

- Dragon Thrownaxe and Dragon Knife from Drakes, Hydras and Wyrms

- Drake's Tooth and Drake's Claw from Drakes
- Dragon Sword and Dragon Harpoon from Wyrms
- Dragon Warhammer from lizardman shamans
- Draconic Visage from dragons in the Catacombs of Kourend
- Sarachnis Cudgel from Sarachnis
- Bottomless Compost Bucket from Hespori
- Dusk Mystic and Dragon Hasta from the Brimstone Chest

param_880,- You are able to get a Slayer Task and cancel a Slayer Task by speaking to a Slayer Master or checking your Slayer status via your Slayer Gem, Helmet, or Ring.

- Superior Slayer creatures have a 1/25 chance to appear.

- Superior Slayer creatures will give Slayer points when killed, based on their Slayer level and difficulty.

- Superior Slayer creatures now have double the number of rolls on the lesser creature's drop table. This does not double the amount of rolls on the Superior Slayer Creature's unique drop table.

- There is a 25% chance a superior monster will appear as a 'Bloodthirsty' version, with boosted offensive stats. This monster will triple the number of rolls on the lesser creature's non-unique drop table, plus a roll on its own unique drop table. They will also drop guaranteed Clue Scrolls if it is on the superior's drop table.

- Expeditious and Slaughter Bracelets will no longer consume charges and have a 35% chance to trigger, up from 25%.

param_880,- You will receive the item: Banker's Note.

- This item will allow you to note and unnote items anywhere in Gielinor.

- You can manually use items on the Banker's Note to un-note or note them all, much like a Bank. Using the Banker's Note on the item will not work.

- The 'Activate' option allows you to note and un-note items in one action with a specified quantity. An object must first be used on the Banker's Note in order for this to work.

- You can customise how many items the Banker's note will note and un-note using the quantity options.

- If lost, you can reclaim the Banker's Note from the Sage near Lumbridge.

- As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

param_880,- All your attacks have an increased minimum hit (10% of your max hit).

- Whenever one of your attacks successfully hits, there is a 50% chance that you will restore your Hitpoints and Prayer by 10% of the damage dealt, rounded up.

- This Relic's restore effect does not work for multi-target attacks or Special Attacks.

- This Relic's restoration effect will work with the Scythe of Vitur's initial hit, however, it will only work for its secondary hits if those hits have the same target as the initial hit. The Restoration effect will only work on the Venator bow's initial hit.

param_880,- When you take fatal damage directly from an NPC or player, you will restore all your hitpoints and Prayer.

(Similar to how chinchompas and other AoE effects work). This effect will only work in the same scenarios that the Retribution Prayer would normally trigger.

- There is a 3 minute cooldown on this effect.

- Cooldown is reset on actual death.

- The damaging effect will not work on NPCs that are recoil immune, with some exceptions:
- Nex
- Hespori
- Vorkath
- All Wilderness bosses

param_880,- You will receive a Guardian Horn which allows you to summon a powerful guardian thrall, lasting 30 minutes.

- The guardian will attack your target with whatever style it is weak to. It will hit much higher than regular thralls and has very high accuracy.

- When you are in multi-combat areas it will attempt to cast an area of effect attack if the primary target is weak to range or magic. This multi-attack can be toggled using the relevant option on the Guardian Horn.

- Min hit: 6, Max hit: 15, Attack Speed: 5, Accuracy: 45000

- You do not need to be on the Arceuus Spellbook to use this Relic, and you can also summon regular thralls alongside the guardian.

- The guardian will not deal damage to other players.

- This relic will also work inside The Gauntlet.

- As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.
